note: Budget for `node scripts/package-size.mjs --check` (CI, P8): the cost, minified + gzip, of an app built from each fixture in tests/fixtures/packages minus the empty app (tests/fixtures/packages/empty.ts). `measuredGzipBytes` is the value when the budget was last set; `maxGzipBytes` is that plus 5%, rounded up, capped at `ceilingGzipBytes` when one is set. A deliberate growth raises the budget (and the ceiling when needed) in the same change, with a one-line reason in `history`.
history: 0.0.0 (tooling, #1, 2026-10-26): first measurement on the empty packages. Each fixture imports its package as a namespace and prints its export names, so the cost is the fixture's own code; the protocol and core pieces replace the fixtures with real use and set the budgets from their first measure.
0.0.0 (protocol, #1, 2026-10-26): the protocol fixture tokenizes a line, quotes the tokens and checks the response with isJsonValue; first measure of the real package.

0.0.0 (core, #1, 2026-10-26): the core fixture builds a console with the core features and runs a command (engine, store, four features, tokenizer); core-all still imports the namespace until the features exist.
0.0.0 (recall, #1, 2026-10-26): core-all becomes a real console with recallFeature (record, browse, clear-recall); completion and context add theirs.
0.0.0 (context, #1, 2026-10-26): core-all adds contextFeature (pushes, pops and resets frames) next to recallFeature; completion adds its own.
0.0.0 (completion, #1, 2026-10-26): core-all adds completionFeature (token at the caret, filter, quoting, session keys) and completes a token; all three optional features are in.

1.0.1 (protocol, #13, 2026-11-04): the protocol fixture also checks an input schema, reads an option line, validates and formats the input, and builds, measures and parses an envelope: the schema checker, the validator, the option line and the envelope are new runtime code (ADR 0012).

1.0.1 (core, #13, 2026-11-04): dispatch reads schema lines (parseOptions, validateInput, formatCommandLine), checks schemas on registration (checkInputSchema), and runs the gate path (envelope, echo, closed ids) and request(); every console now bundles that protocol code, so core and core-all grow by about 4.6 KB.

1.3.0 (core, #13, 2026-11-05): dispatch describes a refused input in words (field, wanted type or bound, the nearest known field by edit distance), carries a CommandError's message to the outcome, turns a string into a list of one and calls a summary function; core and core-all grow by about 850 B.
